# dokku_plugin (Data Source)

Installs or uninstalls a third-party dokku plugin. Installation is a root-level operation, so this task must run over the SSH transport (where dokku wraps privilege server-side) or as root locally. Idempotency is by plugin name only - a changed `url` or `committish` on an already-installed plugin is not detected.

## Example Usage

```terraform
data "dokku_plugin" "example" {
  name = "redis"
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `name` (String) Plugin name as it appears in plugin:list

### Read-Only

- `committish` (String) Optional git ref (branch, tag, or commit) to install
- `id` (String) The resource's identity address.
- `url` (String) Git URL to install the plugin from (required)
